recipes.name: Established causal language models
notes: Runtime path tested with Qwen2.5-3B; this is not verification of every matching repository.

recipes.name: Stable Diffusion XL
notes: Reference SDXL base model tested for native generation/editing on A6000.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 standard pipeline
notes: Adapter implemented, but real FLUX inference remains unvalidated; no CPU offload or quantized variants.

recipes.name: Gemma 4 multimodal weights, text-only API
notes: Loads the full conditional-generation checkpoint; E4B effective parameters do not mean 4B stored parameters.
Text prompts only. Image/audio/video inputs and tool calling are not implemented.
Uses a separate modern Transformers environment; existing 4.x deployments are not upgraded.

recipes.name: Qwen3.8 / Qwen3.5 conditional generation
blockers: Quantization/CPU-offload adapter is not implemented; this 27B BF16 checkpoint exceeds 48 GiB VRAM before KV cache/overhead.
Hybrid linear/full attention and multimodal loading require a modern, separately validated runtime; do not reuse the old causal-LM recipe.

recipes.name: Qwen Image 2.1 generation and editing
blockers: Dedicated QwenImage21Pipeline adapter and modern dependency profile are not implemented; the same pipeline handles generation and editing, unlike the current AutoPipeline split.
The Qwen Research License grants non-commercial research/evaluation use only unless a separate commercial license is obtained; review LICENSE at the pinned model revision.
notes: Count text encoder, image transformer, and VAE weights, not just the advertised 7B image component.

recipes.name: MOSS Image SFT
blockers: Requires repository-provided pipeline/scheduler/transformer Python code. Explicit opt-in, revision/code pinning, and source review must precede execution.
Dedicated loader with mixed BF16/FP32 component dtypes and CPU noise generator is not implemented.

recipes.name: WAN 2.2 T2V A14B original checkpoint
blockers: Video runtime, bounded asynchronous job API, frame/duration limits, and video artifact export are not implemented.

Original checkpoint has separate high/low-noise expert files plus PTH support weights. Published files exceed the current 100 GB server disk; an optimized/converted repository would require explicit selection.
Do not automatically deserialize PTH checkpoints or enable model-provided code.
notes: The upstream single-GPU example specifies at least 80 GB VRAM; A6000 deployment requires a separately validated optimization/offload recipe.
